thread:
maria_support: forwarding an email from ACME — they say responses got "softer" and slightly longer after our model upgrade (v3.2.1 -> v3.3.0). customer pasted examples. says it impacts customer-facing chat UX, asking for a rollback or config knob.

liam_csm: CC'd. they reported this 2h ago. customer is on Dedicated, region eu-west-1, route /v1/chat/completions, model `rwd-llm-3.3.0`.

maria_support: here's the excerpt they sent: 
> BEFORE (v3.2.1): "Thanks — here's the short plan: do X, Y. Let me know what you think."
> AFTER (v3.3.0): "Thanks for your patience. I think we should consider doing X, Y. It might be worth evaluating Z to be safe. Let me know if you'd like me to expand on any of these points."

maria_support: they call it "more hedged, more verbose, and a bit more formal". not a catastrophic quality failure but enough for UX.

devon_oncall: can you paste the exact request headers and example request body (no keys) so we can repro? also any customer prompt engineering / system messages they've set?

maria_support: forwarded minimal curl they used: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED]" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-llm-3.3.0","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize this email in 2 bullets."}],"max_tokens":120}'
```

ashley_engineer: thanks. i'm going to run the same exact call against 3.2.1 and 3.3.0 on a canary account. will paste outputs.

opsbot: deploy v3.3.0 -> prod (canary subset) reported at 1803138000 :white_check_mark:

ashley_engineer: repro steps I ran locally: exact curl above, same system prompt. got these outputs (trimmed):

--- v3.2.1 output ---
"Thanks — here's the summary:
- X
- Y
Let me know if you want more details."

--- v3.3.0 output ---
"Thanks for the information. Here's a brief summary:
- X
- Y
If you'd like, I can go into more detail on any of these points."

ashley_engineer: both correct and safe, but note 3.3.0 adds an optional hedge and expanded opening sentence. subtle.

devon_oncall: any differences in default system prompt or safety layer between those builds? maybe an added guidance line.

ashley_engineer: digging in runtime config now. the model packaging change included a small system-message augmentation introduced by alignment pipeline: appended sentence "Please prioritize clarity and caution when giving recommendations." that could cause extra hedging. confirmed via model manifest in blobstore: `system_suffix: \"Please prioritize clarity and caution...\"` on 3.3.0.

nora_product: tagging product — @nora_product. is that alignment change intentional? was there a spec?

nora_product: we did ask alignment team for a generic safety buffer but this wasn't flagged as behavior that materially changes customer-facing style. will review.

maria_support: customer is asking for either a rollback on their Dedicated pool or a config toggle to opt out of the new suffix. their SLA says we should prioritize.

ashley_engineer: technical options: 1) route that customer's traffic to model variant `rwd-llm-3.3.0-no-suffix` if we have one; 2) patch runtime to strip the suffix at request time for their tenant; 3) roll back their pool to 3.2.1 (requires reserved-capacity migration, 30–45 min).

devon_oncall: can we do (1) quickly? check registry for variant.

ashley_engineer: checking... registry shows `rwd-llm-3.3.0` and `rwd-llm-3.3.0-aligned` (which has extra safety), but no `no-suffix`. looks like our naming got flipped. i can spin a variant by repackaging 3.3.0 without suffix, takes ~12min to build and push to pool.

liam_csm: customer wants minimal churn. they'd prefer targeted variant rather than full rollback.

nora_product: ok please create the no-suffix variant and route ACME's pool to it as a temporary fix. also capture behavioral diff for release notes and consider a prompt-compatibility regression test for future model rollouts.

ashley_engineer: starting rebuild now. will update when done.

maria_support: communicated ETA to customer: ~20–40min. they're relieved. :relieved:

devon_oncall: logging this as ticket SUP-8342. assign to eng-runtime to automate opt-out in future.

opsbot: ticket SUP-8342 created by devon_oncall at 1803141700

ashley_engineer: build finished, pushed variant `rwd-llm-3.3.0-lite` and routed ACME dedicated pool to it at 1803141960.

maria_support: customer confirmed initial messages look like old style. closing loop, asked product to follow up on longer term safeguards.

nora_product: follow-up action items: 1) add a pre-rollout prompt-compatibility check for stylistic regressions, 2) make alignment suffix opt-in for Dedicated, 3) add release notes for packaging changes.

liam_csm: thanks everyone. ACME happy for now.

maria_support: marking thread resolved but keeping ticket open for product actions.
